columns.Patient_ID: Join key shared by every table (EC0000...).
columns.Ages: Age in years, Normal(60,15) truncated to integers and clipped to 30-85.
columns.Ethnicity: Categorical, fixed weights (European 55%, East Asian 15%, South Asian 10%, other groups). Independent of all other variables.
columns.Menopause: Integer code: 1 if Ages <= 51 (pre/peri), 2 if Ages > 51 (post).
columns.Menopause_label: Text label for Menopause: pre_or_peri / post.
columns.Tumor_type: Type1 or Type2; Type2 more likely for age>=60, nulliparous, BMI>=25.
columns.Stage: Ten FIGO-style stage labels (Stage1 ... Stage4B); depends on Grade.
columns.Myometrial_mm: Uniform(2,40). Independent of every other variable (noise column).
columns.Treatment: Surgery/Chemotherapy/Radiotherapy/Combined, uniformly random. Independent of stage (noise column).
columns.Survival_Outcome: Alive/Deceased, generated FROM Stage and Grade. Do NOT use it as a predictor of stage (target leakage).
columns.Late_Stage: Derived label: 1 if Stage is III or IV, else 0.
columns.Batch: Only in batch scenarios: batch id B1..Bk.

columns.<180 protein columns>: Synthetic log2 fold-change vs normal tissue, clipped to [-3,3] (batch scenario: after batch effects, may exceed +/-3). NaN = missing in missing_* scenarios.

columns.<protein columns>: Noise-free expected value = kappa(grade,stage) x sampler mean when the protein's clinical factor applies, else 0. Per-sample ground truth; independent of noise level.

columns.protein: Gene symbol as used in the dictionary.
columns.regulation_raw: Regulation text from the curated dictionary (UP, DOWN, UP/DOWN, LOW).
columns.factor_raw: Clinical factor restricting where the effect applies (NA = everyone).
columns.normal_tissue_regulation_hpa: up/moderate/down from HPA endometrium nTPM (>100 / 10-100 / <10); blank if gene not in HPA. Derived from Human Protein Atlas (CC BY 4.0).
columns.prognostic_flag_hpa: yes if HPA TCGA-UCEC prognostic p-value <= 0.05; blank if gene not in HPA. Derived from Human Protein Atlas (CC BY 4.0).
columns.pathway: Pathway used for correlated noise (blank = none).
columns.n_distinct_regulation_values_in_dictiona: More than 1 = the dictionary lists conflicting regulation for this gene; the first entry is used.

columns.true_effect_log2fc: Mean noise-free expected log2FC of group B minus group A (before noise and clipping).
columns.is_nonzero_effect: True if the generator gave a non-zero expected difference; False = true null. For Late_vs_Early_stage and Grade3_vs_Grade1 this is the intended signal. For Postmenopausal_vs_Premenopausal and Type2_vs_Type1 tiny non-zero values also arise from indirect associations (age -> type -> grade -> kappa), so prefer true_effect_log2fc or is_large_effect there.

columns.batch_gain: Multiplicative gain applied to the whole batch.

columns.*: Generator version, seed, n, scenario parameters, rho, thresholds. Together with the code this reproduces the files.
